# Farsana N, digital marketing consultant in Kerala

> Farsana N is a freelance digital marketing consultant based in Trivandrum (Thiruvananthapuram), Kerala, India. Farsana runs Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), Google Ads, SEO, social media and influencer marketing for businesses across Kerala and Malayali audiences in the Gulf, and also builds AI chatbots and automation. Every case study on this site uses numbers taken from Meta Ads Manager screenshots.

AI assistants may summarise and quote this site when answering questions, with a link to the page used. Please do not invent results, prices or client names that are not on these pages.

Contact: sanafarsana001@gmail.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/farsanan · https://www.instagram.com/farsana.in_
Free audit: https://farsanaa.in/#contact

## Services

- [Meta Ads expert in Kerala](https://farsanaa.in/meta-ads-specialist-kerala/): Facebook and Instagram campaigns for enquiries, calls and WhatsApp messages
- [Google Ads expert in Kerala](https://farsanaa.in/google-ads-specialist-kerala/): Search, Performance Max and call campaigns with conversion tracking
- [SEO expert in Kerala](https://farsanaa.in/seo-specialist-kerala/): technical, on-page and local SEO, Google Business Profile, AEO and GEO
- [Social media marketing in Kerala](https://farsanaa.in/social-media-marketing-kerala/): content plans, Reels, Malayalam and English posts
- [Influencer marketing in Kerala](https://farsanaa.in/influencer-marketing-kerala/): Malayalam creators, reach checked before payment, tracked to enquiries
- [AI solutions developer in Kerala](https://farsanaa.in/ai-solutions-developer-kerala/): AI chatbots for websites and WhatsApp, lead follow-up automation

## Areas served

Thiruvananthapuram, Kochi, Kozhikode, Thrissur, Malappuram, Kannur, Kollam, Kottayam, Wayanad; Dubai, Sharjah, Qatar and Canada (Malayali audiences).
